This file is for doing data import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
Import out first dataset
```{r}
litters_df =
  read_csv(file = "data_file/FAS_litters.csv")

# makes it into snake case 
litters_df =janitor:: clean_names(litters_df)
```
Import the pups dataset
```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv(file = "data_file/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3)
  
pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df) 
  
```

## Look at the data 
```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail of the dataset 
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)

tail(pups_df, 5)
```

skimming? 
using :: is for when you want to use one feature of a package without loading the whole package. 
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```

viewing- don't do this in R markdown just in the command 
```{r}
# view(pups_df) 
```
